message.content: In the discussions regarding the picnic arrangements, MuradinBronzebeard suggests adding cushions to the existing benches, which he believes would make the space more comfortable for hanging out at the garden. However, he also proposes adding tables near the benches for people to place drinks or snacks, indicating that he sees these tables as a useful addition for facilitating social gatherings and snack-sharing. While MuradinBronzebeard primarily focuses on enhancing the comfort and functionality of the garden seating areas, he recognizes the value of having picnic tables for family gatherings and communal dining. Therefore, MuradinBronzebeard is one of the proponents of adding picnic tables for families to enjoy some snacks after playing.
